entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to pull up the account?
Jane Doe. The order is VF8675309.
Thank you, Jane. One moment... Okay, I see the order. And may I ask why you're returning the sensor?
I just don't like it. It's surprisingly hard to use, and the whole app interface is confusing. I just expected more from it, I guess.
I understand. Did you get a chance to look through the setup guide?
I looked at the user manual, yes. It didn't help. I want to send it back.
Okay, no problem. Let me just check the delivery date here... It looks like it was delivered 25 days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days for a return, so you are well within the window.
Fine. So you'll take it back?

Yes, absolutely. I'm processing the return now and I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. You'll receive a full refund once it's processed at our warehouse.
Whatever. As long as I get my money back.
You certainly will. The email with the label is on its way. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
